newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas futures trade 20 pct of UK demand on day o.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas futures trade 20 pct of UK demand on day o.

text.p: The new gas futures contract on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) traded the equivalent of 20 percent of the UK's gas consumption on its first day of trading, the exchange said on Friday.
A total of 465 lots were traded on Friday the equivalent of some 14 million therms with an underlying value of about 2 million stg.

"The exchange is very encouraged by the first day of trading in this new contract and sees this launch as the first step towards a truly competitive European gas market," said Lynton Jones, the IPE's chief executive.
"The UK gas market now has a real-time, transparent price structure which goes twelve months into the future. I am delighted by the high level of support for this initiative," he said.
